input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 fully satisfies the preferred position. § 11.1 triggers on expiry or termination for any reason and gives us up to six months of transition assistance (knowledge transfer, export support, migration, continued service at existing scope and service levels), priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form — more favourable to us than the preferred "then-current rates". § 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and bars withholding for fee disputes. § 11.3 requires secure deletion after we confirm successful return, with written officer certification, and keeps any law-required retained copy protected and use-restricted. The only wording gaps are minor and non-adverse: the thirty-day clock runs from our request rather than from termination (we control the trigger) and deletion follows our confirmation of return rather than return alone. No conflicting immediate-deletion or data-hostage language appears elsewhere (§§ 10, 15). No redline required.
